items.stem: The critical path of a project is:

options.text: The longest sequence of dependent tasks, determining the shortest project duration
options.rationale: Correct: the critical path sets the minimum time and has zero float.

options.text: The sequence of the most expensive tasks
options.rationale: Cost does not define the critical path.

options.text: Any path with the most tasks
options.rationale: It is about duration of dependencies, not task count.

options.text: The list of tasks assigned to the project manager
options.rationale: Ownership does not define the critical path.
